claim: Use controlled fixtures with identical player states and the same time and random sources in both runs; natural encounter divergence is not pace evidence and identical seeds mean input is not arriving.

evidence.text: Trials drifted apart until every time source of the logic was read from the round counter in both runs; then lockstep for 160-600 rounds.
Put the objects' own bytes in the audit state list: a time-dependent read before a fixed random sequence moves the sequence.
Natural-play traces diverge through R-dependent encounters and are not pace evidence; controlled pace trials over several starting video phases meet 2%.
Two pace seeds with identical numbers meant input was not reaching the game.
